newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS says pay deal averts March 7 strike.
newsitem.headline: SAS says pay deal averts March 7 strike.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Wednesday that it had reached a pay deal with ground staff, averting a strike planned to begin March 7.

The one-year deal gives sales, check-in, cargo-handling and administrative staff a 1.5 percent raise. Staff in posts where more flexible hours and conditions are introduced would receive a further 1.5 percent flexibility bonus, an SAS statement said.

SAS, which has a history of stoppages, said that the agreement with the LFF ground staff union, reached without labour court intervention, reflected an improvement in industrial relations over the past year.
"It is most satisfying to state that for the first time in 10 years it has been possible to reach a voluntary wage deal with LFF," Personnel Director Christian Christensen said.
